instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): needlong = input(true, defval = true, title = "Long"); needshort = input(true, defval = true, title = "Short"); sizelong = input(100, defval = 100, minval = 1, maxval = 10000, title = "Lot long, %"); sizeshort = input(100, defval = 100, minval = 1, maxval = 10000, title = "Lot short, %"); fast = input(20, minval=1); slow = input(50, minval=1); showof = input(true, defval = true, title = "Show offset"); showll = input(true, defval = true, title = "Show lines"); showdd = input(true, defval = true, title = "Show label (drawdown)"); showbg = input(true, defval = true, title = "Show background"); fromyear = input(1900, defval = 1900, minval = 1900, maxval = 2100, title = "From Year"); toyear = input(2100, defval = 2100, minval = 1900, maxval = 2100, title = "To Year"); frommonth = input(01, defval = 01, minval = 01, maxval = 12, title = "From Month"); tomonth = input(12, defval = 12, minval = 01, maxval = 12, title = "To Month"); fromday = input(01, defval = 01, minval = 01, maxval = 31, title = "From day"); today = input(31, defval = 31, minval = 01, maxval = 31, title = "To day") | Indicator calls: highest(high, fast); lowest(low, fast); highest(high, slow); lowest(low, slow); highest(100)
exit: Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.exit("Long", stop = center, when = needlong and strategy.position_size > 0); Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.exit("Short", stop = center, when = needshort and strategy.position_size < 0)
stop_loss: strategy.exit("Long", stop = center, when = needlong and strategy.position_size > 0); strategy.exit("Short", stop = center, when = needshort and strategy.position_size < 0)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Third-party Pine source; verify execution timing, pyramiding, and broker-emulator semantics before implementation.
